tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Free-text search over the SFXMint library of free CC0 sound effects. Use it for sound descriptions, additional constraints or gaps left by another tool. Choose get_role_sound for a named event or get_sound_set for multiple events when that fits the task; these are task branches, not a fixed sequence

tools.name: get_role_sound
tools.description: Choose this when the task calls for a sound for a named event or interaction — a button click, purchase success, error beep, level-up, dialogue blip, notification. Pass the role as plain words: role ids (click, success, purchase-success, dialogue-blip, notification…) and common aliases (button click

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Get full metadata for one sound by slug, including download URLs, description and acoustics measured from the WAV (silence before the sound, where it peaks, audible length, attack, tail, brightness, levels, character labels).

tools.name: get_sound_set
tools.description: Get a coherent set of sounds for an app or game in one call — one sound per role, with format metadata, hashes and stable download URLs. Use it when the task needs a whole kit; use get_role_sound for one event. Listen to the files in context. Sets include UI styles, game and app scenarios, acoustic-

tools.name: studio_list_link
tools.description: One link to SFXMint Studio for every sound the library lacks in this task: pass each missing sound as a short description and give the user the returned user_message once, instead of one link per sound. The page lists them ready to make one by one with a generation pack, each heard before a credit i

tools.name: generate_sound
tools.description: Make an individual sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit; it then returns generate_available). For continuous environmental beds or instrumental background music, use generate_ambience or generate_mus

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check a generation started with generate_sound, generate_ambience, generate_music or change_sound: status, kind and fresh download links for the finished takes, including loop_url when a loop was made.

tools.name: change_sound
tools.description: Change one take of a generation this account made, from the take itself: say what is off in the user's words (change, any language) or name the action. Three versions come back (a light, medium and strong change; for a loop, three seams) as CC0 WAV files. Free: no generation is used and no plan is n

tools.name: generate_ambience
tools.description: Make a continuous environmental sound bed such as rain, waves, a forest or a crowd, not a musical track or an isolated event. Makes 30-second CC0 WAV takes and attempts seamless loops. Needs an SFXMint API key and credits or a plan; sound-effect free tries do not apply. Missing access returns websit

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Make instrumental background music (BGM), including ambient music, for an app or game; for environmental sounds use generate_ambience. Makes 30-second CC0 WAV takes and attempts to extract repeating musical loops. Needs an SFXMint API key and credits or a plan; sound-effect free tries do not apply.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "generate_music" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
